thread:
marta: Heads-up — Starlake RFI landed. They want the capability matrix, POC timeline, and answers to the security questionnaire by EOD Friday. Can we map owners?
devin: I can own the POC infra checklist and the Dedicated capacity pricing section.
kevin: I’ll take the capability matrix and the model-comparison tab. Will need product for tiny clarifications.
emma: I’ll own the security questionnaire (SaaS + Private options) and KMS/HSM answers. looping in @security-team for the HSM SLA wording.
sales-bot: Reminder: RFI due in 72 hours — upload attachments to sales-drive or the portal.
security-team: Thanks @emma. Quick Q: do we have a current HSM SLA doc for Private deployments? If not, we need a short statement about customer-managed key custody and audit logs.
emma: We have a draft but it’s behind legal review. I can provide a transitional answer: "customer-managed KMS with optional HSM integration; Redwood supports key policies, customer rotation, and audit exports." Mark as "subject to legal approval."
marta: That wording sounds fine for the RFI as long as we add a follow-up note that Private deployments support HSM via our on-prem package and we’ll attach the HSM diagram.
kevin: Starlake specifically asked about model pinning + canary rollouts in Dedicated. Proposed matrix cell: "model pinning: yes; canary rollouts: supported via per-route rollout policies with traffic split and automatic fallback." Thoughts?
devin: Add an ops note: "canary rollouts are supported in Dedicated with configurable SLOs; automated fallback to a compatible variant if latency or error rate exceeds threshold."
emma: Security Q item 14 asks for data residency controls. Suggested answer: "Hosted API: regional tenancy and data controls; Dedicated/Private: customer-controlled VPC and storage; we support contractual data residency commitments for Enterprise."
marta: Pricing question from Starlake: what’s POC pricing for 3-month Dedicated pilot with 8x A100 equiv? Sales asked for high-level number and unit economics. @devin?
devin: For a 3-month pilot we usually do a discounted commit at ~65% of list for Dedicated baseline, plus an ops onboarding fee. Rough ballpark: $65k–$90k/mo depending on GPU equivalence and throughput targets. Will prepare a short table with anchors.
kevin: Can we include an example run-rate calculation showing token cost vs. Dedicated cost for their 10M tokens/day baseline? They asked for comparative unit economics.
devin: Yes — I'll draft a 2-row calc: Hosted per-token (x cents/token) vs Dedicated amortized cost (hosted-equivalent tokens per GPU).
marta: Attachments — we should upload: capability_matrix_starlake.xlsx, poc-runbook.md, hsm-diagram.png, security-answers.pdf. I'll drop links once uploaded.
sales-bot: Upload complete: https://files.redwood.com/sales/starlake/capability_matrix_starlake.xlsx
sales-bot: Upload complete: https://files.redwood.com/sales/starlake/poc-runbook.md
sales-bot: Upload complete: https://files.redwood.com/sales/starlake/hsm-diagram.png
sales-bot: Upload complete: https://files.redwood.com/sales/starlake/security-answers.pdf
kevin: Quick note on the matrix: include cells for "quantization profiles", "latency SLOs (p50/p95)", "KV/prefix caching", "model variants + fallback", and "observability retention (token-level)" — Starlake cares about cost/latency tradeoffs.
emma: For the security questionnaire, add: SOC2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integrations, RBAC/SCIM support, and audit log retention options.
marta: POC timeline: Week 0 — onboarding & infra prep; Week 1 — smoke benchmarks; Week 2-4 — workload tuning + evals; Week 5-12 — production-like load test and metrics validation. We should flag a gating item: customer needs to approve network peering and quota in Week 0.
devin: Ops blocker: quota request for burst capacity needs 72h lead time. Note in runbook.
kevin: Also call out fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity falls below threshold, traffic routes to hosted compatible variant — include link to routing policy doc: https://docs.redwood.com/routing/fallbacks
emma: Security-team: please confirm the specific phrasing for HSM SLA and whether we can say "HSM integration available for Private deployments; HSM vendor and certification details provided upon request."
security-team: Confirmed. We can use that phrasing and add: "detailed vendor/attestation info provided through NDA or Customer Security Review."
marta: Final ask — sales needs a one-pager for execs summarizing value: cost comparison, risk mitigations, timeline, and key asks from customer. I can draft if you all OK with the technical bullets.
devin: OK. I’ll send the cost table by EOD.
kevin: Matrix done draft by tomorrow morning; will include screenshots of p95 latency under 2048 tokens.
emma: Security answers PDF is ready for internal review — sending to legal now.
marta: Great. I’ll assemble the RFI packet and post final zip to the portal. Thanks team :rocket:
__notes: No title field; single-thread string; messages are short and Slack-style; attachments referenced as external links.
